matching_rule: Exactly one specification per planned document ID; no extras.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Controlled cover, version record, people/non-operative charges, allegation chronology, bail-event timeline, live application/order/condition and deadline map.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 5-7 pages; 250-450 words per narrative page or 10-22 sourced events/rows per table page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital accessible PDF with searchable text, stable links and compact repeated control headers.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Pending order reference, corrected hearing time and unresolved CTL input retained through dated revisions.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Open orientation excludes privileged strategy, witness contact data and unnecessary medical/financial detail; role variants enforce permissions.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No copied submissions, generic bail law, repeated chronology, decorative forms or blank padding.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Concise charge/context pack with charge record, MG5-style allegation summary, signed core statements and exhibit schedule; supplies proportionate context without trying the merits.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 7-10 pages; summaries/statements 250-450 words/page and exhibit tables 8-20 rows/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Mixed signed scans and born-digital summary/schedule; native media referenced by hash rather than reproduced.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Witness uncertainty, incomplete vehicle-use attribution and corrected exhibit label allowed with history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Commercial and contact data minimised; only properly served context reaches defence/client/court.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No wholesale trial bundle, repeated statements, irrelevant exhibits, generic offence prose or duplicated images.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: vehicle use not exclusive by inference

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Certified antecedent, identity-matching, prior attendance, failure-to-surrender, order and bail-history records with a reconciliation schedule.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 6-9 pages; records at authentic sparse density and reconciliation tables 8-18 entries/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Certified or system-produced records with legible scanned orders; born-digital reconciliation schedule preserves exact source wording.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Alias, unmatched old arrest, corrected disposal and missing legacy order permitted as explicit uncertainty.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Criminal-record and identity data limited to necessary hearing recipients; client explanation avoids unrelated details.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repeated antecedent printouts, unverified police summaries, irrelevant history, empty rows or artificial risk narrative.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: old and current conditions not merged

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Prosecution bail representations with witness-safety source material, risk schedule, proposed restrictions and service record; separates evidence from advocacy.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 7-10 pages; representations 300-500 words/page and risk/condition tables 6-16 rows/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital filed representations plus controlled statement/contact extracts; signature or filing stamp retained.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Late witness update, narrowed proposed condition and corrected source reference retained with revision history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Witness addresses/contact routes and internal risk deliberation restricted; court/defence receive only lawful served evidence.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repeated allegation summary, generic exception language, invented victim view, duplicated conditions or unsupported risk score.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: later update does not rewrite earlier submission

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Defence bail proposal comprising address-provider statement, residence verification, employer rota, treatment evidence, surety/security proposal, means proof and condition schedule.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 8-11 pages; statements/letters 250-450 words/page, financial evidence selectively tabulated and no unnecessary medical record bulk.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Mixed signed letters/scans and born-digital proposal; bank/health extracts narrowly cropped or redacted with source authenticity retained.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Changing rota, incomplete monitoring consent, partial bank period and updated appointment allowed with explicit versioning.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Defence privilege until authorised; account numbers, diagnoses and third-party contact details minimised by audience.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No full medical file, full bank history, repeated references, invented verification or proposal treated as court approval.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: First-remand application and response, hearing attendance/note, reasons, order and service/explanation record; authoritative initial decision lifecycle.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 8-11 pages; prescribed-style forms/orders at authentic density, submissions 250-450 words/page and concise hearing chronology.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital forms/submissions and signed or sealed order/hearing record; superseded draft visibly marked.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Oral clarification, corrected condition wording and perfected-order delay allowed without silent replacement.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Filed material role-available; privileged attendance notes restricted; protected witness/health details minimised.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No invented reasons, duplicate orders, repeated submissions, generic legal tests or unsigned draft presented as operative.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Condition-variation application, changed-circumstance evidence, response, service, hearing record, decision and varied/refused order with before/after comparison.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 6-9 pages; application/response 250-450 words/page, prescribed-style order pages and comparison tables 5-12 conditions/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital filed papers and signed/sealed order; source employment evidence cross-linked rather than recopied.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Late rota, narrowed request, adjournment and correction to effective time retained with full history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Employment/contact data minimised; privileged rationale restricted; filed proposal and order available by role.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No duplicate original bundle, repeated conditions without comparison, invented employer proof or proposed wording shown as operative.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: old order retained and marked superseded only where proper

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Alleged-breach arrest grounds, digital-contact exhibit/register, D1 response, court hearing/opinion, renewed bail decision, operative-order history and CTL/deadline worksheet.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 9-13 pages; incident records 250-450 words/page, digital/order/deadline tables 8-20 rows/page and authentic forms.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Mixed arrest-record scans, native digital item retained by hash with readable exhibit, born-digital deadline worksheet and signed/sealed court order.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Missing native platform return, disputed sender, clock offset, competing CTL start inputs and later perfected order retained transparently.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Witness and irrelevant account content restricted; defence privilege excluded; CTL internal checks separated from filed applications.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No screenshot repetition, invented sender attribution, duplicate orders, automatic CTL conclusion or breach allegation presented as fact.
